design_objective: Remove exhaustive negative-comparison persistence and/or exhaustive competitor traversal as the population-scale bottleneck while preserving auditable Candidate-Tracklet-ObjectAssertion identity and terminal matching behaviour. Any evidence-representation delta must be explicit, versioned and falsifiable rather than disguised as physical compaction.
permitted_design_search: Indexed competitor retrieval keyed by hard scope and candidate-specific necessary predicates, with proof that no eligible positive match can be omitted.

Aggregate or commitment-based representation of negative comparison coverage instead of one materialised JSON evidence vector per impossible competitor, while retaining deterministic audit reconstruction or verification properties.
Separation of scientific terminal-decision semantics from diagnostic negative-evidence representation, with an explicit versioned evidence contract.
Candidate-specific indexing strategies for A, B and C only where they preserve each candidate's frozen positive-match predicates; no threshold, source or candidate-set change is implied.
Streaming/checkpoint designs whose storage growth is bounded by declared state/evidence complexity rather than all-pairs comparison count.
required_invariants: Candidate identities and source-record identities unchanged
Positive-match predicate truth values unchanged on bounded exact-reference equivalence populations
Terminal match decisions unchanged on bounded exact-reference equivalence populations unless a separately operator-ratified semantic amendment explicitly states otherwise
Tracklet and ObjectAssertion lifecycle outcomes unchanged on bounded exact-reference equivalence populations unless separately operator-ratified
No sampling, reduced precision, hidden threshold or population change
Negative-evidence representation changes must be explicit and versioned
Determinism, restart/checkpoint integrity and fail-closed behaviour preserved
No real-source semantic execution during design or qualification
required_work_if_pass: Produce a bounded semantic-scalability design record comparing at least exact-output preservation, outcome-equivalent evidence compression, and indexed necessary-predicate retrieval strategies.
Define the authoritative equivalence target: exact full evidence-stream equivalence versus terminal-outcome/lifecycle equivalence with a new explicit negative-evidence contract.
Implement only the selected bounded research-sidecar candidate runtime generation after its design choice is recorded.
Run adversarial exact-reference tests across A/B/C, including ambiguity, discontinuity, equal-time ordering, restart and duplicate fail-closed cases.
Demonstrate subquadratic or otherwise bounded competitor/evidence growth on synthetic hard-scope-density sweeps and quantify worst-case storage/time complexity.
Run complete repository regression and produce a new capacity qualification on GitHub-hosted execution substrate.

Only after qualification prepare a separate C2P2-RS0-FRESH-GRUN-R4 gate; that later gate must independently request any new runtime binding, evidence-contract amendment, capacity envelope and exactly one fresh real-source token.
explicitly_not_authorised: Candidate removal, replacement or scientific promotion
Probability, risk, exposure, trading, execution or agent-write authority
Force push, destructive cleanup or main merge
